reviewer: TC execution-contract reviewer; also authored some included test cases
review_scope: Static contract authoring review against the approved full H2 plan and integrated inventory. This is not independent source review, runner review, pre-gate, execution authorization, or acceptance.

authority_and_scope.evidence: The contract pins the exact approved plan and integrated-ledger hashes. It preserves the approved full 25-obligation H2 scope, 407 retained cases, 83 additions and 490-case union. The stage predicates require exact collection and 490 fresh passes, with no narrower H2 substitution.

stage_fields_and_sequence.evidence: All five stages (FULL-ATTEST, FULL-COLLECT, FULL-EXECUTE, FULL-AUDIT, FULL-FINAL-REVIEW) contain purpose, target, method, agent, pass_criteria, expected, evidence and recovery. Collection precedes execution; full privacy/resource audit and independent final review follow it.

inventory_execution_mapping.evidence: The 15-phase execution order and every phase cap match the integrated ledger exactly. The caps sum to 15,420 seconds, and the outer gate is 16,020 seconds, allowing the stated 600-second outer margin. Case-level collection, execution and timing requirements defer to the hash-pinned literal ledger.

budget_and_cleanup.evidence: The contract preserves 49 new 215+25-second cases and 34 new 25+5-second cases, the 60-second per-phase allowance, 5-second SQL lock and 30-second SQL statement limits, and 10-second RPC limit. It requires a single shared cleanup epoch including fixture and final-session teardown, rejects timeout flags, retains ownership on cleanup failure, and does not count parent recovery as a passing case.

hung_driver_oracle.evidence: It distinguishes the real pg_sleep/local-statement timeout from the worker self-watchdog and requires independent actual backend disappearance by the pre-query event plus 40 seconds before rollback/recovery assertions. No parent SQL cancellation or early restart can satisfy this oracle. The pinned amendment explicitly says this timing remains unexecuted.

environment_and_isolation.evidence: The contract prohibits installs/downloads and remote/company services, pins existing interpreters and binaries, limits endpoints to owned loopback Temporal and private Unix-socket PostgreSQL, and requires explicit environment isolation and unique owned storage.

evidence_privacy_and_publication.evidence: Publication is restricted to six fixed archive members with deterministic metadata and explicit transformations. Raw histories, logs, credentials, source archives, process identities and absolute paths remain private; the contract requires independent comparison of every public member against the raw private evidence.

authorization_separation.evidence: All candidate authorization flags remain false. Exact paired independent/TC contract-and-ledger approvals may authorize only runner authoring. Test/service execution still requires exact final runner source review and independent/TC pre-gate approval; H2 acceptance and full-goal acceptance remain separate.

requirements_and_omissions.evidence: B03 H2, REQ-02, REQ-13, REQ-14 preservation and AT-16 prerequisite-only are named. Node/build/browser validation, actual agents/devices/company SSO/cloud/deployment/submission and broader B03/H3-H7/AT32/full AX remain explicitly outside this candidate gate with residual risks retained.

limitations: I authored some included test cases. This verdict is a static contract review and does not independently establish that source methods reach their asserted cuts or satisfy product behavior; the separate senior review is required.
No imports, collection, tests, SQL, service startup or network operations were performed. The runner is not authored, and no environment or runtime behavior is qualified by this report.

The NEG-WINDOW exact-deadline clock seam remains conditional on its approved isolated single-assignment method and independent source review. The real unmodified-runtime before/after cases remain mandatory and cannot be replaced by seam results.

The native PostgreSQL hung-driver disappearance deadline, Temporal/SDK history behavior, subprocess cleanup, fixture finalization and publication transformation remain unexecuted risks that must be proven by the later reviewed runner and full gate.

authority.runner_authoring: This TC review approves the contract for the paired runner-authoring gate only; runner authoring is not authorized until the independent exact contract and ledger reviews also approve.
authority.next_gate: Independent exact contract review and paired source/ledger approvals, followed by runner authoring, exact runner review, and independent/TC pre-gate before any imports, collection, tests or services.
